description: Trade mark search across TMview (EUIPO's TMDN network: EUIPO, WIPO and 70+ national offices incl. US, CN, AU, AR): mark name, office, status, application/registration numbers and dates, expiry, Nice classes, applicant, protected territories, image link. Name-contains search, optional office filter. Data as published by each office in TMview; not legal advice and not a full clearance search. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
